regulation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 + FSSAI Licensing Regulations 2011

net_quantity.label: Net Quantity
net_quantity.rule_explanation: Net quantity must be declared in standard metric units (g, kg, ml, L). Font size must be proportional to principal display panel area.
net_quantity.pass_condition: Found with valid numeric value and standard unit
net_quantity.fail_condition: Completely absent from all visible panels
net_quantity.warning_condition: Detected on package flap/bottom (flap pointer found)
net_quantity.penalty: Fine up to Rs. 25,000 for first offence

mrp.label: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
mrp.rule_explanation: MRP must be declared inclusive of all taxes. Format: 'MRP (Incl. of all taxes) Rs. X' or '₹ X'. Must appear on principal display panel.
mrp.pass_condition: MRP found with Rs./₹ symbol and numeric value
mrp.fail_condition: MRP not found on any visible panel
mrp.penalty: Fine up to Rs. 50,000 and/or imprisonment up to 1 year for repeat offence

manufacturer.label: Manufacturer / Packer Name & Address
manufacturer.rule_explanation: Complete name and address of manufacturer, packer, or importer must appear on the principal display panel.
manufacturer.pass_condition: 'Manufactured by', 'Packed by', 'Marketed by', or 'Imported by' found with name

manufacture_date.label: Month & Year of Manufacture
manufacture_date.rule_explanation: Month and year of manufacture, packing, or import must be declared. Acceptable formats: MM/YYYY, Month YYYY.
manufacture_date.pass_condition: MFG date found in valid date format

use_by.label: Best Before / Use By / Expiry Date
use_by.rule_explanation: Best before or use-by date is mandatory for perishable and packaged food items.
use_by.pass_condition: Expiry/BBD date found in valid format
use_by.fail_condition: No expiry or best-before date found
use_by.warning_condition: Expiry date found on package flap/bottom

consumer_care.label: Consumer Care Details
consumer_care.rule_explanation: Consumer care contact — phone number (preferably toll-free) or email — must appear on the package.
consumer_care.pass_condition: Phone number or email address found associated with consumer/customer/helpline keyword
consumer_care.warning_condition: Contact found but without consumer-care keyword context

fssai.label: FSSAI License Number
fssai.rule_citation: Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulations, 2011 — Regulation 2.1
fssai.rule_explanation: All food business operators must display their 14-digit FSSAI license/registration number on every package.
fssai.warning_condition: Partial FSSAI reference found without full 14-digit number
fssai.penalty: Fine up to Rs. 5 lakh and/or licence cancellation

country_of_origin.label: Country of Origin
country_of_origin.rule_explanation: Country of origin must be declared. For India: 'Made in India' or 'Manufactured in India'.
country_of_origin.pass_condition: 'Made in', 'Manufactured in', 'Product of', 'Country of Origin' found
country_of_origin.fail_condition: No country of origin declaration found
country_of_origin.warning_condition: Not applicable — either found or missing
